mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} and match_id = #{matchId} and match_type=#{matchType}

SELECT t.matchType, t.matchId, t.title, t.sport, t.status, t.matchDate, t.startTime, t.endTime, t.placeName, t.participationFee, t.maxPeople, t.minPeople, t.currentPeople FROM ( SELECT 'Personal' AS matchType, m.personal_match_id AS matchId, m.title, m.sport, m.status, m.match_date AS matchDate, m.start_time AS startTime, m.end_time AS endTime, m.place_name AS placeName, m.participation_fee AS participationFee, m.max_people AS maxPeople, m.min_people AS minPeople, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM personal_match_participant pp WHERE pp.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id AND pp.status = '결제완료') AS currentPeople FROM favorite f JOIN personal_match m ON m.personal_match_id = f.match_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.match_type = 'Personal' AND m.sport = #{sport} AND m.status = #{status} AND m.match_date >= #{startDate} AND m.match_date <= #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 'Team' AS matchType, m.team_match_id AS matchId, m.title, m.sport, m.status, m.match_date AS matchDate, m.start_time AS startTime, m.end_time AS endTime, m.place_name AS placeName, m.participation_fee AS participationFee, m.match_people AS maxPeople, /* 정원인 match_people을 maxPeople로 */ 0 AS minPeople, /* 팀 매치는 최소 인원이 없으므로 반드시 0 처리 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_match_participant tp WHERE tp.team_match_id = m.team_match_id AND tp.status = '결제완료') AS currentPeople FROM favorite f JOIN team_match m ON m.team_match_id = f.match_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.match_type = 'Team' AND m.sport = #{sport} AND m.status = #{status} AND m.match_date >= #{startDate} AND m.match_date <= #{endDate} ) t ORDER BY t.matchDate ASC, t.matchType ASC, t.matchId ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM ( SELECT m.match_date AS d FROM favorite f JOIN personal_match m ON m.personal_match_id = f.match_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.match_type = 'Personal' UNION ALL SELECT m.match_date AS d FROM favorite f JOIN team_match m ON m.team_match_id = f.match_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.match_type = 'Team' ) t
